articles.headline: Steven Stamkos scores on OT power play as Predators beat Avalanche 3-2
articles.description: — Steven Stamkos scored a power-play goal 2:18 into overtime, Justus Annunen made 30 saves and the Nashville Predators beat the Colorado Avalanche 3-2 on Thursday night.

articles.headline: Gauthier strikes again to help the Ducks beat the Oilers, 5-4
articles.description: — Cutter Gauthier became the first Anaheim player with nine goals in a four-game span, scoring and adding an assist in the Ducks' 5-4 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Thursday night.
